content.text:
Plan settled. Relaying the first build unit.

```dispatch
TO        build
GOAL      Add coupon field to checkout form
SCOPE     src/checkout/** only; worktree acme-checkout, branch feat/checkout
CONTEXT   Design note in docs/coupon.md
ACCEPT    Coupon code applies a discount
  Invalid code shows an inline error
VERIFY    scripts/verify-checkout.sh
TIMEBOX   2h
FORBID    merge, force-push, out-of-scope edits
REPORT    status, branch, head SHA, verdict, memory-save
TIER      standard
```
